    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[0] * (3*m) for _ in range(3*n)]
    for br in range(3):
        for bc in range(3):
            # Reflect tile horizontally according to checkerboard; vertically by band.
            flip_v = (br % 2 == 0)
            flip_h = (bc % 2 == 0)
            for r in range(n):
                for c in range(m):
                    sr = n-1-r if flip_v else r
                    sc = m-1-c if flip_h else c
                    out[br*n+r][bc*m+c] = grid[sr][sc]
